archiveLocationBySite.description: If archive location changes based on site

archivePath.description: The location of the recordings stored on disk

archivePathMappings.description: A list of archive paths mapped to sites, used when ArchiveLocationBySite is true

daysUntilArchive.description: The number of days until a recording is archived

daysUntilDelete.description: The number of days before a session recording is deleted

enableDelete.description: If session recordings will be automatically deleted

enableHardwareAcceleration.description: If hardware acceleration should be enabled

enableInactivityTimeout.description: If sessions should end if inactive

enableOnDemandVideoProcessing.description: If on demand video processing should be available

enableSessionRecording.description: Whether or not Session Recording is enabled

encryptArchive.description: If archived session recordings should be encrypted

hideRecordingIndicator.description: If the recording indicator should be shown

inactivityTimeoutMinutes.description: The length of inactivity before the session is ended

maxSessionLength.description: The longest a session is allowed to be in hours

rdpProxyRecordKeyStrokes.description: If proxied RDP sessions should have keystrokes recorded

rdpProxyRecordVideo.description: If proxied RDP sessions should have video recorded

sshProxyRecordKeyStrokes.description: If proxied SSH sessions should have keystrokes recorded

sshProxyRecordVideo.description: If proxied SSH sessions should have video recorded

storeInDatabase.description: If session recordings should be stored in the database

useTemporaryArchives.description: If the archive location should store temporary session recording data instead of the database

videoCodecId.description: Which video codec to use for session recordings on OSX

ConfigurationSessionRecordingSiteArchive.description: The session recording archive locations that are mapped to specific sites
